name: com.hapbeat.sdk
description: Unity SDK for Hapbeat haptic devices

samples.description: Smallest possible Hapbeat scene — keyboard input fires a few events. Use to confirm the device connection works.
One scene, 5 zones, covering every Hapbeat wiring pattern (collision / state behaviour / sequence / tick / script). Keyboard + mouse only — no XR device needed. Import and press Play.
Optional helpers for XR Interaction Toolkit (HapbeatXRGrabFilter etc.). Import only when XRI is in your project.

Haptics for the XR Interaction Toolkit "Hands Interaction Demo" scene. Ships the EventMap and Kit only — import the XRI demo yourself, then run Hapbeat > Samples > Augment XRI Hand Demo to apply the wiring. Requires the XR Helpers sample.
Minimal VR (Quest) example for on-device verification (address override, test haptics). No XRI dependency.
